extraction_text: In order to achieve this goal, the parties hereby recognize the Employer's right to determine the methods, processes and means of providing services, to increase, diminish, or change equipment, including the introduction of any and all new, improved or automated methods or equipment and the assignment of employees to specific jobs within their respective job classifications within the bargaining unit.

Except as limited by an express provision of the Agreement and subject and subject to RCW 41.44 and the Raymond Civil Service Rules, the Employer shall retain the right to exercise the customary functions of management, so long as those functions do not constitute a unilateral change in wages, hours, and/or working conditions; including: directing the activities of the Police Department, determining the levels of service, methods of operation, introduction of new equipment, the right to hire, layoff, transfer, promote, discipline, discharge determine work schedules, assign work and determine time and location of an employee's work shift.
